Stage 5 · Java foundations

Abstract Classes

Half-drawn blueprints. Concrete rooms ready; blanks enforced.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Bake ready, flavor blank

Never serve dry mix.

🍰

Cake mix. bake() fully instructed (concrete); flavor() blank (abstract). Can’t serve mix — bake Vanilla child first. new Cake()? BANNED, forever.

Cake sketch
abstract class Cake {
  void bake() { System.out.println("Baking..."); } // ready
  abstract void flavor();                          // YOUR job
}
class Vanilla extends Cake {
  @Override
  void flavor() { System.out.println("Vanilla!"); } // debt paid
}
Cake c = new Vanilla(); // abstract ref, concrete object
c.bake();
c.flavor();
Children pay ALL debts or stay abstract. Abstracts may still hold state, constructors, concrete code — a family WITH furniture.
